_readme: The text of Memory (SI_Journal.js). Quests, clues and words are switched on by events; see the plugin's help. Keys are ids used in events. 'notes' are margin notes by actor id, shown once that member has been in the party. Lines starting TODO only show in playtests.

words.title: Mouth-words
steps: Look at the things here. \N[4] says the words.
\N[4] wants to see my face. In the water, in the light.
words.done: I have words now. And a face, in the water.

cuts.text: Little cuts on the bones. Neat ones. Sib says it's how priests make an animal ready for the gods.

temperament._readme: Memory's 'What I'm like' page. var: the count's variable. tiers: [count, what it gives]. Add the body-era tiers later.
temperament.title: What I'm like

bones.where: The small bones, in the tube where I woke.
bones.taught: Bones! Everybody's got them. On the inside. Usually.

sleep.where: The old graves by the tube.
sleep.taught: Sleepers. They're sleeping a long, long time. Shh!

star.where: The sword in the teal tomb.
star.taught: Star-iron! It fell out of the sky. From a star!

head.taught: That's a head-bone. Somebody was mean to it.

jar.taught: Jars! Things go in. Stinky things.

rope.where: The coil of rope by the tombs.
rope.taught: Rope! For tying and climbing and tripping.

up.where: The broken ladder under the light.
up.taught: Up! That's where the sky is.

fire.where: The old fire outside the tombs.

sit.where: The log by the old fire.
sit.taught: Sit! You put your bottom down. Do you have a bottom?

food.taught: Food! My food. You don't eat, lucky.

rock.taught: Rock! Rocks are everywhere. Don't worry about rocks.

notes.4: You said 'Sib'! Who's Sib? Is Sib a rock?

down.where: The cracked tomb, where warm air comes up.

remember.taught: The Red Bowl remembers things for you. That's 'remember'.

together.where: The children's cairns by the sky-hole.
together.taught: Two kids stacked this together! Like you and me.

sky.taught: Sky! That's the biggest thing there is.

sun.taught: And that's the sun. Don't look at it.

goat.taught: A goat! They eat everything and climb everything.

grass.where: The kipuka garden by the sky-hole.
grass.taught: Grass. It grows where the fire didn't.

float.where: The warm crack in the old flow front.
float.taught: That's a crack. You go over it. Float! That's what you do.

water.taught: Water! You know water. You saw your face in it.

tree.where: The dead tree in the channels.
tree.taught: A tree. A dead one. Everything here is a bit dead.

bird.where: The ravens in the dead tree.
bird.taught: Birds! They can see you. Birds see everything.

wind.where: The gusty saddle in the channels.
wind.taught: Wind! You can't see it either. You're the same!

sing.taught: The wires sing! People talk through them. Far away.

road.taught: A road. People walk on it to go places.

fighting.title: Fighting
text: The line at the top says whose turn it is. Fast ones get more turns.
Fight is for hitting. Talk is for talking it down: animals listen, sometimes. Tactics is guarding, the bag, catching your breath, or running.
I can barely hurt anything, and things can barely hurt me. My moves are in Fight, then Innate: the touches, the wails, the cries.
\N[4] gets tired (FT). Too tired, and she has to catch her breath.

notes.4: I'll do the hitting. You do the spooky.

gathering.title: Picking things
text: \N[4] showed me. Lots of things on the island can be picked: plants, rocks, water.
Some need tools, like a knife or a digging stick. Some only certain people can pick. Cave things are \N[4]'s.
Once something's picked, it's gone till tomorrow. Then it grows back.
